_comment: Authoritative gate list for LaunchPilot. Ship flags on `pilot run` are opt-in CLI overrides of the stop-at-PR default.

ship_flags._comment: CLI only — never implied by products.json alone. --ship never includes App Store submit.
ship_flags.app_store_submit: optional — pilot appstore-submit <product> --dry-run (safe) or --confirm / run --ship-appstore (real). Not covered by --ship.
